summary: Blue Owl Real Estate Net Lease Trust filed an 8-K to report an unregistered sale of 18,520,740 common shares for ~$198.3 million at NAV per share (as of May 31, 2026), exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D/S. It also declared monthly distributions ($0.0625 gross per share minus servicing fees). This is a routine equity issuance and dividend declaration; no special-situation event is involved.
